subject: Pricing alignment & PO timeline for Quantica pilot
messages:
From: Ethan Price <ethan.price@quanticalabs.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sourcing Ops <sourcing@quanticalabs.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:14:00-04:00
Subject: Pricing alignment & PO timeline for Quantica pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers you showed for short-chat flows look promising. We're preparing an internal packet for a 90-day pilot and I'm driving commercial questions on our side. Quick items we need to lock down before the PO: 

- Pilot pricing model: do you prefer a capped token-based pilot or a seat-based pilot for evaluation? Quantica currently prefers predictability (we like a seats + burst credit model) but we'll consider tokens if the cap is explicit.
- Discounts/credits: can Redwood offer any onboarding credit or a pilot discount? Our procurement is pushing for either a one-time credit applied to first invoice or a flat 20% off list for the pilot period.
- Packaging: we need to confirm whether model variants used in the pilot (gpt-open-45b-q4) count the same as production pricing or are considered a “beta” variant with a different rate.

I've attached our RFI to give you context. Can we get a short commercial proposal by EOD Thursday so I can pass it to sourcing and legal? If we can align quickly, procurement can issue PO the following week.

Thanks,
Ethan

[Attachment: Quantica_RFI_2026.pdf (PDF)]

Ethan Price
VP of Product, Quantica Labs
ethan.price@quanticalabs.ai
+1 415-555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Price <ethan.price@quanticalabs.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T11:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment & PO timeline for Quantica pilot

Ethan — thanks for the clear ask and the RFI. Quick responses inline and a concrete option below.

- Model pricing: for pilots we recommend a seats + burst credit approach for predictability. Tokens work too but we see less friction with a seat allotment + pooled token bucket (we can cap at X tokens/day).
- Discount/credit: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit or a pilot discount. Two practical options: 
  1) $10k onboarding credit + standard usage rates (recommended for speed)
  2) 15% off list for the 90-day pilot across the model family you test.

- Model variant billing: production vs pilot variants are billed at the same published SKU rates unless you opt into an experimental build — if you want the q4-optimized variant at a different rate we can document that in the SOW.

Proposed MOP (minimal operating plan): 3 seats, 500k token pooled cap over 90 days, onboarding credit option #1. We can convert that into a one-page commercial offer and a PO-ready DocuSign link. Attached is a quick CSV with the proposed caps.

If you want to accept option #1 I can loop in legal and ops to remove auto-renew language and set clear exit acceptance criteria. Can we hop on 30 minutes today at 2pm PT?

Best,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: pilot-mop.csv (CSV)]

> Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers you showed for short-chat flows look promising. We're preparing an internal packet for a 90-day pilot and I'm driving commercial questions on our side. Quick items we need to lock down before the PO: ...

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T12:30:00-04:00
Subject: RE: Pricing alignment & PO timeline for Quantica pilot (internal)

Marissa / Jonas — quick internal note after reviewing the ask and the proposed options.

- Concession limits: sales can offer up to a $12k onboarding credit or 15% pilot discount without CRO approval. Anything beyond that requires a formal discount memo.
- Legal redlines to pre-clear: remove automatic renewal at pilot end; define data retention to match Quantica's security questionnaire (they flagged egress logs); add a 7-day SLA credit for outage > 5m during pilot.
- Billing model: prefer seat + pooled token cap to reduce egress surprises; require PO to reference deal id QNT-3491 and include acceptance criteria doc.

I'll prepare a short redline to the MOP and attach the finance-friendly version (redlines-pilot-mop.xlsx). If you need me to join the 2pm call I can take legal/ops questions.

Connor
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redlines-pilot-mop.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Ethan Price <ethan.price@quanticalabs.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sourcing Ops <sourcing@quanticalabs.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T08:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing alignment & PO timeline for Quantica pilot

Marissa — appreciate the fast turnaround and Connor's notes. Quantica is willing to accept a middle ground to keep timelines. Confirming the following: 

- Commercial: 3 seats, 500k pooled token cap over 90 days.
- Credit: 15% off list for the pilot period (we prefer percentage over a fixed credit this time).
- Contract: no auto-renew, explicit acceptance criteria in SOW, include SLA credit clause for pilot.

If you can send the PO/DocuSign with those bullets and the HubSpot deal updated to QNT-3491 we will route for signature today. Procurement has asked for a link to the final PO and a copy of the SOW to be attached to the invoice.

I can sign once DocuSign is live. Thanks — looking forward to getting this spun up.

Ethan
VP of Product, Quantica Labs
ethan.price@quanticalabs.ai
